Hi, I'm Katie Mehrtens, and I am the owner of The Right Spot Pet Massage.  I am a nationally certified small animal massage therapist and offer therapeutic massage for all breeds of dogs, cats, and other small animals. 

I created this channel to share some of my knowledge about pet massage with you. My intention is to provide you with some at-home tools you can use with your pet.  

Please know that all animals are different and will react / respond differently to massage. So, what works one time or on one pet may not work the next time or on another pet. Never force the massage – if your pet does not want to be massaged, stop and try again another time.

A few notes:
• These are simply informative videos
• Massage is not a replacement for veterinary care
• See your vet if your pet seems to be in pain
• Never massage deep on your pet. The idea of “it will hurt now, but feel better later” does not apply to animals
 
Thanks so much for tuning in!
Please enjoy these videos!
